name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
summary: Krusk sends you north to Lord Aliden Perenolde's manor by Lordamere Lake. Once Perenolde is dead, his mistress Elysa can tell you about the Warchief's pendant.

sections.title: The Lord of the Syndicate
sections.body: After Blackmoore's Legacy, Krusk sends you to end Perenolde's foulness. His manor stands at Dandred's Fold, on the shores of Lordamere Lake to the north. Once Perenolde is dead, ask his mistress Elysa about Taretha's pendant. The Warchief desires it.

sections.title: A Frightened Mistress
sections.body: Elysa is terrified when you reach her. She cries that she never meant your people harm. Perenolde kept her against her will, she says, and she begs you to spare her.

faq.answer: After you finish Blackmoore's Legacy, Krusk sends you to kill Lord Aliden Perenolde.

faq.q: Where is Lord Aliden Perenolde located?
faq.answer: Perenolde is upstairs in his manor at Dandred's Fold, on the shores of Lordamere Lake to the north.
Lord Aliden Perenolde leads the Syndicate.

faq.q: What item are you sent to retrieve after killing Perenolde?
faq.answer: After Perenolde is dead, ask his mistress Elysa about Taretha's pendant, which the Warchief desires.

aliases: what is after lord aliden perenolde
faq.answer: Taretha's Gift comes next in the chain.
